summary: Complete initial source-scope chronology audit of all 177 Chinese units, all 31 temporal or active-hint items, and all 9 extracted people. Directly named Liao imperial deaths and contemporaneous funeral participants are supported at their stated event years. Three generic office/title records, however, combine separate ritual occurrences into invented AD 1031–1101 personal activity intervals; their claims, hints, and false-person records require repair. No source or canonical extraction data was changed.
